summary: A work item was created; the line says what it was asked to be, so where the work came from is answered without reading the item.

role.description: The role that performs ai_role work; null for a provider operation.

operation.description: The canonical operation a provider_op item performs; null for a role's work.

contact_id.description: The person the work is about, or null.

not_before.description: The moment before which the work does not start, or null.

due_at.description: The moment the work expires if it has not finished, or null.
